text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy ran well even in the GⅠ race. 
While public perception didn't change 
much, she realized she still had fans 
cheering her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching the race at the camp lodge, Biko 
Pegasus wanted to know the secret behind 
that strength— continuing to run 
undaunted, even through the jeers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Shinko Windy stated that even 
if she kept being treated as a gag 
character, she would endure it until her 
grand ambition was realized.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If you have that resolve, skipping a GⅠ 
for now in favor of a stage where you can 
steadily prove your strength would be 
ideal. We set our next target on the 
graded Tokai Stakes.
